matchups.tips: He outranges you (and every other ADC) by a lot, so fighting is often not possible. Try your best to avoid his Q's as they're the main source of his damage. Avoid trading unless it's an all in, as there is close to no chance you'll be able to outtrade him (if you can even reach him in the first place), and ensure that you have your E or Flash to disengage.

A very tough matchup for Caitlyn. His E is about equal to your auto attack range, making it very hard to trade into him. Avoid trading/fighting if at all possible, and ensure that you have your E or Flash to disengage.

While you do outdamage Seraphine, you'll almost never be able to hit her. She outranges you by quite a lot, and with her shields, heals, raw damage output, slows, roots, stuns and charms, she proves to be a very hard matchup for Caitlyn. Avoid trading as it will usually lead to you being cc'd and damaged out of your range, and ensure that you have your E or Flash to disengage.

Avoid trading unless you're ahead by a substantial amount (and can 100% win the fight), as he will always be able to beat you in an extended fight if left alive long enough. The standard build does a decent job of 100-0'ing Kog'Maw, so if possible play to reach at least 2 items before trying to take a fight with him.

Avoid all in fights, as she will block all your auto attack damage (headshots included). She wins extended fights as well as all ins, so your best chance to win is to play around her auto attack blocking shield timer (Around 20-30 second CD)

Similar to Nilah, you should typically avoid all in fights. His Q damage buff very often will dwarf your extended trade damage. He wins extended fights as well as all ins, so your best chance to win is to play around your E + Q combo, by baiting him into range.

Twitch is a hard champ to play into as Caitlyn, but mostly if your team doesn't know how to play against a Twitch. If thats the case, always play far back and ensure that you have eyes on Twitch before you commit to any fights.

While Caitlyn does outrange Corki heavily, you need to ALWAYS play around your E + Q, as his gap closer can easily lead to you being one shot before you even have a chance to react. Never trade if you don't have your E ready.
You outrange her heavily, however with improper spacing, she can EASILY get ontop of you and you will NEVER win that fight. Play far enough back to where she can't dash to you.
You outrange her, but it's important to remember she can easily get ontop of you with her jump, and burst you with her E+R combo.
He's not an incredibly big threat unless he's able to get a big lead. Play smart during laning phase and you'll have no problem dealing with him.

Use your range to your advantage in this lane, but remember that you're highly vulnerable to his root. He's a hard match up at all stages of the game and it's important to keep in mind his burst as well as his sustain in extended fights.
She does have lower range than Caitlyn, which makes laning not incredibly hard. However, keep in mind that she DOES burst you harder and has the ability to close that gap.
Try your best to not let her make it out of lane without putting her as far behind as possible. She will outscale you.
Her spellshield makes it very hard for you to win trades, as she can block your (almost) guaranteed headshot that E provides you.
Zeri isn't an incredibly hard match up. You outdamage her in most stages of the game. Just be wary of her full combo without vision.

You both have a high range, however, ashe has much more consistent poke. Be sure to play around your minion wave and avoid being pushed up too far as she can and will run you down if given the chance.
He outranges you, does very decent poke damage as well as all in / burst. Play back and try to survive the lane.

You can dominate this lane by using your range to your advantage, however, do NOT trade into her if shes able to play inside her wave. It's very hard to get a headshot on someone when they are able to play behind the minions. She does outscale you, hwoever, she may not be able to get to you if you position properly.
Avoid all-ins with her, poke using your range, and don't play around low hp minions.
You outrange him for the entire laning phase, just remember not to stay in lane with too low hp or he can ult you.
Hard to play against a good varus on almost any champ, however, with the right plays you can work around it. Try to survive the early game and make sure to avoid his ults late game.
She doesn't do a great job of laning against Caitlyn, but remember that you'll almost never be able to kill her with your R post-6.
